PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "http://localhost:5173/api/tickers?symbols=%5ERUT,BTC-USD,BZ%3DF,300750.SZ,BRK-A,AEPGX,ARKVX,ZZFAKE99"; \($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).tickers | ForEach-Object { "{0,-10} ok={1,-5} closes={2,-4} name={3}" -f $_.symbol, $_.ok, $_.closes.Count, $_.name })

PowerShell($p = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "https://stint-ledger.vercel.app/tickers"; "page: HTTP $\($p.StatusCode\), $\($p.Content.Length\) bytes"; $a = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "https://stint-ledger.vercel.app/api/tickers?symbols=%5EGSPC,AEPGX,BTC-USD"; "api: HTTP $\($a.StatusCode\), cache-control: $\($a.Headers['Cache-Control']\)"; \($a.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).tickers | ForEach-Object { "{0,-8} ok={1,-5} closes={2,-4} {3}" -f $_.symbol, $_.ok, $_.closes.Count, $_.name })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; foreach \($tf in @\('1D','1W','1M','6M','YTD','1Y','5Y','All'\)\) { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "http://localhost:5173/api/tickers?symbols=%5EGSPC,AEPGX,BTC-USD&range=$tf"; $t = \($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).tickers; "{0,-4} GSPC={1,-5} AEPGX={2,-4} BTC={3}" -f $tf, $t[0].closes.Count, $t[1].closes.Count, $t[2].closes.Count })

PowerShell("page: " + \(Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "https://stint-ledger.vercel.app/tickers"\).StatusCode; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "https://stint-ledger.vercel.app/api/tickers?symbols=%5EGSPC,AEPGX&range=1Y"; $t = \($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).tickers; "1Y: GSPC closes=$\($t[0].closes.Count\), AEPGX closes=$\($t[1].closes.Count\)")

PowerShell($r = $null; foreach \($i in 1..10\) { try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:5173/api/tickers?symbols=AAPL,BTC-USD,AEPGX&range=1D"; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800 } }; if \($null -eq $r\) { "no response" } else { $r.tickers | ForEach-Object { "{0} ok={1} price={2} closes={3} ahPrice={4} ahPct={5} state={6}" -f $_.symbol, $_.ok, $_.price, \($_.closes | Measure-Object\).Count, $_.afterHoursPrice, $_.afterHoursPct, $_.marketState } })
